baselineDrift: Context picker and source preview work changed resource ports and added local picker ranking; external recommendation discovery still follows the audited selection-dependent hooks.

paths.problem: selection/style/sort/workspace revision participate in effect identity; cache hits still refresh
selection/context participate in signature; cache lacks freshness; display can disappear when selection changes

baselineRegression.direct: visible feed disappeared on deselection; 350 ms debounce batches repeated effects, not a stable-feed contract
baselineRegression.note: Deterministic local regression. These are adapter calls, not a measurement of upstream provider fan-out.

storageDecision.native: Existing SQLite IMMEDIATE transactions and expected-version CAS already enforce desktop_identity.local_object_scope. Use recommendation/v2/ records for leases, reservations, events, profiles, tombstones and snapshots. No parallel database or vector service.
storageDecision.web: Existing IndexedDB readwrite transactions implement the same CAS contract.
storageDecision.sync: Explicitly exclude recommendation/v2/ from native and browser asset sync categories before storing private derived state.
storageDecision.vectors: Keep existing semantic_index. Partition by model/endpoint/revision/dimensions/task/normalization; never compare vectors across spaces.

contracts.freshness: Fresh display/candidate snapshots return without discovery, embedding or reranking. Legacy caches are stale pools.
contracts.identity: owner + workspace + feed + policy epoch; selection changes cannot become a feed ID. Explicit exploration freezes submitted seeds.
contracts.publication: Expected version CAS, source watermark, generation and lease fence must agree. Clear/invalidate cancels old work and waits already dispatched writes.
contracts.budgets: Rolling 24h ledger; provider reservations count retries and citation expansion, model requests and tokens count separately. Legacy cloud reports unknown upstream usage; never claim a measured six-call upstream cap.
contracts.migration: Preserve v1 annotations/profile/style/model references/private-text permissions. New reading/questions/generation permissions default off; future versions remain protected.
